author: Arpan Lamichhane
review_text: App is good but the customer service is the worst 👎👎👎. For simple issue you have to call them 5-10 times, they will ask you to email and create new issue ticket but will close the ticket without even fixing the issue. If you call them to inform about the unsolved issue they will again ask you to send email and repeat the process but still no response. 🤬 Update: fed up with their customer service....... Deleting my account and installing esewa asap. 👎
